escena: SCENE (a marketing team reviewing its AI visibility, a modern meeting room at dusk, NO faces): seen from high above at a steep angle, a current-generation tablet with thin bezels and an aluminium frame lies flat on a bare dark walnut meeting table in LANDSCAPE orientation, its long side horizontal, large in the frame and placed in the RIGHT part of the frame: its left edge is at about 36 % and its right edge at about 92 % of the frame width; its screen is ON and shows a perfectly flat, evenly lit, PURE WHITE blank rectangle edge to edge, with nothing on it — no text, no icons, no reflections, no glare, no fingerprints — clearly visible and NOT covered by any finger or object, so a real interface can be placed on it later. MOMENT: mid-gesture, caught at the instant two people lean in at once — one hand enters from the bottom edge and its index finger is about to touch the lower right corner of the tablet frame (on the aluminium frame, never on the screen), another hand from the top right rests a slim black pen on the table beside it. Only hands and forearms in dark navy and charcoal sleeves, no faces, no heads. The tablet's white glow is the brightest thing and lights the fingertips and the table around it. On the table: only one closed matte navy notebook and the pen; the table is otherwise BARE — no mugs, no plants, no papers, no laptops, no phones. The cool dusk light of a window, out of frame on the left, rakes in azure-blue across the left part of the table. 35mm, f/4, everything unbranded. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this vertical photo sits in the right column of a full-screen menu whose dark panel overlaps its LEFT third with a large curved corner at the top; so the SUBJECT and everything that carries the idea sits in the CENTRE-RIGHT of the frame, and the left third is calm continuation of the same scene, never empty and never a flat slab.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus near edge of the dark walnut meeting table at the very bottom of the frame
